unresolved_when_any: direction can reverse under observed repeat-device fidelity envelope
numerical_assessment.envelope: Sum of the two candidates maximum observed absolute fidelity discrepancies on the20 prespecified repeat indices. Finite diagnostic evidence, not a uniform error bound.
numerical_assessment.statement: Numerical flags never change statistical CIs or their directions. Unresolved contrasts cannot support superiority claims.
numerical_assessment.bootstrap_sensitivity: Report50k and100k direction agreement separately as statistical sensitivity, not as numerical error.

overall_label_convention.qualified_favorable_contrast: Original adjusted50k CI favors candidate;100k direction agrees; numerical assessment resolved; both pulses pass simultaneous engineering certification.
overall_label_convention.CONFIRMED: All six directed favorable contrasts qualify.
overall_label_convention.PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED: At least one but fewer than six directed favorable contrasts qualify.
overall_label_convention.caveat: A NOT_CONFIRMED label refers to favorable-order claims, not validity or value of negative/mixed research. Significant inferiority and all individual results remain reported.

publication_readiness.statement: A complete numerically interpretable simulated-device study permits manuscript preparation with limitations; publication requires a defensible novelty/model-scope argument and appropriate external evidence.
